Lewis Hamilton won the most races at Circuit of the Americas between 2000 and 2025, with 5 wins (2012, 2014, 2015, 2016 and 2017).

The circuit hosted 13 races in that period. Max Verstappen was next with 4 wins (2021, 2022, 2023 and 2025). Sebastian Vettel, Kimi Räikkönen, Valtteri Bottas and Charles Leclerc each won once.

ANSWER: Lewis Hamilton
